act.name: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
act.source_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
act.description: Central law for children in conflict with law, children needing care and protection, rehabilitation and adoption.

sections.title: General principles to be followed in administration of Act.
sections.text: Section 3 states the child-centred principles that guide administration of the Juvenile Justice Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Authorities must follow dignity, best-interest, participation, privacy and other child-protection principles.

sections.title: Inquiry by Board regarding child in conflict with law.
sections.text: Section 14 governs inquiry by the Juvenile Justice Board concerning a child alleged to be in conflict with law.
sections.plain_language_summary: Explains how the Juvenile Justice Board conducts an inquiry involving a child accused of an offence.

sections.title: Child Welfare Committee.
sections.text: Section 27 provides for constitution of the Child Welfare Committee.
sections.plain_language_summary: Establishes the district Child Welfare Committee for children needing care and protection.

sections.title: Prohibition on disclosure of identity of children.
sections.text: Section 74 prohibits disclosure of identifying information about children covered by the Act, subject to its exceptions.
sections.plain_language_summary: Protects a child's identity from publication or disclosure in Juvenile Justice matters.
